title: Senior AI Engineer — Founding Team
skills_required: Production experience with embeddings-based retrieval systems (e.g., sentence-transformers, OpenAI embeddings, BGE, E5), including handling embedding drift, index refresh, and retrieval-quality regression in production.
Production experience with vector databases or hybrid search infrastructure (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, Milvus, OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, FAISS), with operational experience.
Strong Python programming skills, with attention to code quality.
Hands-on experience designing and implementing evaluation frameworks for ranking systems (e.g., NDCG, MRR, MAP, offline-to-online correlation, A/B test interpretation).
skills_preferred: Experience with learning-to-rank models (XGBoost-based or neural).
Prior exposure to HR-tech, recruiting tech, or marketplace products.
Background in distributed systems or large-scale inference optimization.
Open-source contributions in the AI/ML space.
experience_required: 5–9 years of experience, with a strong emphasis on senior engineer judgment. Must include 4-5 years in applied ML/AI roles at product companies, having shipped at least one end-to-end ranking, search, or recommendation system to real users at meaningful scale. Not suitable for pure research roles, recent LangChain-only LLM projects without prior ML production experience, or those who haven't written production code in the last 18 months.
responsibilities: Own the intelligence layer of Redrob's product, specifically the ranking, retrieval, and matching systems.
Audit existing systems (BM25 + rule-based scoring) and identify 3-4 highest-leverage improvements.
Develop and ship a v2 ranking system (involving embeddings, hybrid retrieval, and LLM-based re-ranking) that demonstrably improves recruiter-engagement metrics.
Establish robust evaluation infrastructure, including offline benchmarks, online A/B testing, and recruiter-feedback loops.
Drive the long-term architecture for scalable candidate-JD matching.
Mentor the next round of engineering hires.
Collaborate closely with the recruiter-experience Product Manager on product development.
industry: AI-native talent intelligence platform, HR-tech, recruiting tech, marketplace products.
technologies: Embeddings-based retrieval systems (e.g., sentence-transformers, OpenAI embeddings, BGE, E5)
Vector databases/hybrid search (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, Milvus, OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, FAISS)
LLMs (for re-ranking, fine-tuning with LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT)
leadership_expectations: Take full ownership of the product's core intelligence layer.
Drive architectural decisions for large-scale systems.
Mentor junior engineers and contribute to team growth.
Demonstrate deep technical expertise combined with a pragmatic, shipping-oriented approach.
Formulate and defend strong technical opinions on key ML/AI approaches (retrieval, evaluation, LLM integration).
product_mindset: Possess a scrappy product-engineering attitude, willing to ship functional solutions quickly to gather user feedback even if initially suboptimal.
Actively consider product implications, recruiter workflows, and evaluation frameworks.
Bias towards shipping and learning from real users ('shipper' archetype) rather than pure research.
Focus on designing robust systems rather than just applying frameworks.
Comfortable with rapid iteration and challenging internal assumptions, moving fast and breaking things (internal assumptions).
must_have_skills: Minimum 4-5 years in applied ML/AI roles at product companies (not pure services).
Proven track record of shipping at least one end-to-end ranking, search, or recommendation system to real users at meaningful scale.
Comfortable with deep technical depth in modern ML systems (embeddings, retrieval, ranking, LLMs, fine-tuning).
Possesses a scrappy product-engineering attitude, willing to ship quickly and learn from users.
Actively writes production code and has done so in the last 18 months.
Demonstrated understanding of retrieval and ranking concepts prior to the recent LLM trend (substantial pre-LLM-era ML production experience).
Has strong, defensible opinions about retrieval, evaluation, and LLM integration, backed by built systems.
Commitment to the role for 3+ years (not a 'title-chaser').
Focuses on systems thinking over framework enthusiasm.
Has prior product-company experience (if currently at a consulting firm).
Primary expertise is in NLP/Information Retrieval, not solely computer vision, speech, or robotics.
Has external validation of work (papers, talks, open-source) if work has been entirely on closed-source proprietary systems.
nice_to_have_skills: Comfortable with async-first work and extensive writing.
Comfortable with open disagreement and quick decision-making.
Adaptable to a fast-moving, evolving codebase and environment.
Located in or willing to relocate to Noida or Pune.
Active on the Redrob platform or demonstrates clear signals of being in the job market.
